title: Boundary geometry and linear accessibility of functions with positive real derivative
summary: We study the boundary geometry of the Noshiro--Warschawski class $\mathcal{R}$. Using the geometric structure of close-to-convex domains and their relation to Loewner chains, we investigate the boundary behavior of functions in $\mathcal{R}$. In particular, we discuss the relation between spherical length and local connectedness, and show that the boundary of the image domain of a function in $\mathcal{R}$ need not be locally connected.
